title: Dumb Shoplifter Thinks He Can Outsmart Police After Stealing a Lawnmower
description:
On April 27th, 2024. Home depot contacted police regarding a man who just stole a $500 lawnmower. Police then pulled the man over, only to discover that he had been using a fake ID, had expired tags to a vehicle he did not own and had a warrant from a different state.
